name: ryder-cup-functions
description: Cloud Functions for the Ryder Cup tracker (score alerts) and their tests. The website itself does not use npm.

scripts.test: npm run sync && node --test test/events.test.js test/score-log.test.js
scripts.rehearse: npm run sync && MOCK_PUSH_LOG="$PWD/.rehearsal-pushes.jsonl" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-ryder-rehearsal "node test/rehearsal.mjs"
